snippet.title: Rent Out Together | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Renovate together. Rent it out. Deal with the aftermath.

Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4640760/Rent_Out_Together/

Turn filthy houses into welcoming rentals in Rent Out Together, a renovation and rental simulator for 1–4 players.

Play solo or team up with friends to clean, paint, furnish, and redesign your properties. Take listing photos, welcome guests, and grow from a small studio to seaside villas.

Some guests leave five stars. Others leave a disaster.

#RentOutTogether #coopgaming #simulationgame
